result.title: CHD-Bench: Diagnosing Congenital Heart Disease through Interactive Examination
result.comment: 21 pages (8 main + references + appendix), 9 figures, 11 tables. Code: https://github.com/Maitri-Labs-Amrita/CHD-Bench
result.summary: Diagnosis of congenital heart disease (CHD) requires understanding the spatial relationships between cardiac structures, which clinicians assess by scrolling through CT or cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) slices and rotating 3D reconstructions. Although automated methods have advanced cardiac segmentation, identifying congenital heart defects from volumetric scans remains an open challenge. The two existing approaches rely on handcrafted diagnostic rules limited to static anatomical abnormalities. We introduce CHD-Bench, the first benchmark for interactive CHD diagnosis, defining a multi-label task and evaluation protocol over 247 CT and MRI scans from three cohorts covering 38 CHD types. We also present CHD-Harness, open-source software that runs a VLM in a 3D Slicer environment through 22 tools, manages each examination, and records the resulting diagnosis and supporting views. We evaluate off-the-shelf medical, open weight, and closed weight VLMs and compare them with a 3D CNN classifier and published rule-based results. Gemini 4 Argon with CHD-Harness achieves the highest macro F1 across all three cohorts (0.63, 0.63, and 0.43). Allowing for interactive examination raises its macro F1 by up to 20 points over static views. These results establish CHD-Bench and CHD-Harness as a foundation for developing and evaluating VLMs for interactive CHD diagnosis.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出首个交互式先天性心脏病诊断基准 CHD-Bench，覆盖 247 例 CT/MRI、38 种疾病，并提供 22 个工具让 VLM 在 3D Slicer 中滚动切片、旋转重建并记录支持诊断的视图。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「交互查看—证据记录」设计直接关联 VLM 推理中的视觉证据获取与动态检查；静态视图改为交互检查最多提升 20 个 macro F1 点，可供核查证据筛选的收益与检查成本，但未涉及 latent 状态生成。
